name: Caprese Toast with Tomato, Fresh Mozzarella & Jalapeño-Cilantro Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, sugar, cumin, and salt. Whisk to combine the lime mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the lime mixture. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the jalapeño-cilantro sauce; set aside.
Arrange bread on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Meanwhile, slice mozzarella and tomatoes into thin rounds.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkgs fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide toast between plates. Top with mozzarella, tomatoes, and jalapeño-cilantro sauce. Enjoy!
